about: Lines of the three supplied documents (01 to 03) that WIA's rulings R-1 to R-16 supersede (backend/docs/WIA-Rulings-2026-10-18.md), decided by the engineer under D21 (E.B25 c). The compiler applies them to the carried-over documents from `effective` on: `remove` drops the line, `annotate` keeps it and appends the bracketed note, `replace` writes `replacement` and the note. A line is matched by its exact text (trailing spaces aside) and must occur exactly `occurrences` times, or the compile stops naming it. `lines` are the line numbers in the committed supplied documents, for the reader; the supplied originals are never edited.
